name: sprocket_520_45t
description: Aluminium 7075-T6 rear sprocket for a 520 chain — radial tooth repetition, PCD mounting circle and lightweight cutouts.

stages.prompt:
Aluminium rear sprocket (7075-T6) for a 520 motorcycle chain, parametric.

Frame: flat disc on the XY plane, centred at origin, 6 mm thick (Z).
- Chain 520: pitch 15.875 mm, roller diameter 10.16 mm.
- 45 teeth evenly spaced on the pitch circle; tooth profile follows the 520 standard (involute/roller seat), tooth gap leaves room for the 10.16 mm roller with clearance.
- Derive the tip diameter from the chain spec: tip dia ~= (pitch / sin(180/45)) + roller diameter - small seating offset (~236 mm outer diameter).
- Central bore dia 30 mm.
- Six M8 mounting holes dia 8.5 mm on a common pitch circle of dia 80 mm, 60 degrees apart.
- Six rounded lightweight cutouts (kidney/oval pockets) between the mounting circle and the tooth ring, leaving webs of at least 6 mm; all cutout edges rounded (radius >= 3 mm).
- All outer edges broken with a 0.5 mm chamfer.
Parametric: tooth count, pitch, roller dia, body thickness, PCD and cutout count as named parameters.
